newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end at record high for sixth day.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end at record high for sixth day.

text.p: Austrian shares end at a record high for the sixth day running, closing up 0.17 percent at 1,390.58 points but traders say the latter part of the session marked by profit taking.
Mood seen very positive. ATX seen short term between 1,380 and 1,400 points.
*11 losers outweigh nine gainers with one unchanged
*Top gainer Leykam, up 4.18 pct at 334.95 ats
*July ATX future up 7.0 points at 1,403 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
